label: EXPLORATORY: linked pair economics per maker fill, session runtime

metadata.denominator: maker fills (one row per maker fill; bps over the maker fill price); net and interval only for fully hedged fills
metadata.dependence: rows of one block (a day by default) are resampled together in the bootstrap interval; no fill is treated as independent of its day
metadata.notes: simulated fill price at hedge arrival (size-aware where the venue book has depth; with best bid/ask only, as Binance in March 2024, the touch is assumed to fit the size); the pair leaves out funding and the cost of an unwind
